items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Where is Macy's Lisa? On O’Farrell near Powell?

ctx.x: Did that for about five years. Gene Kelly had his show here called “Clown Around.” Lisa said somebody else was in it. Anyway the thing called “Clown Around” they played in Oakland Auditorium and played over here in the Cow Palace. And the couldn’t afford it because the paraphernalia was so extravagant and it was too costly to move. So they ended it right here. But Gene Kelly, it was his show, he wasn’t in it. He didn’t perform in it, but it was his show. He’s the one that produced it and everything. And I met him…
